facts: The present keep is 20.2 m high including 1.7 m shachi and has three levels. The documented exterior stone platform is 12.54 m high on its measuring elevation.
The 13.8-m first floor is approximately square. The 1970 rebuild uses copper cladding in place of the earlier cypress roof. The highest level is the observation room.

record: City of Suwa Takashima Castle record
facts: The keep, moat corner and reconstruction are shown as the modern castle destination; the reconstruction opened in 1970.
